belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that metric orientation specification test may influence correlation rank spearman values. The evidence base (9 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: metric orientation specification test → [unknown mechanism] → correlation rank spearman values

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of metric orientation specification test, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of metric orientation specification test on correlation rank spearman values replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for metric orientation specification test effects on correlation rank spearman values?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
